d:
Allie Clifton, Robin Lopez and Isaiah Thomas break down LeBron James’ first triple-double as a Sixer and Philadelphia’s 111-104 NBA Cup win over the Miami Heat. The crew discusses LeBron’s performance as the 76ers improve to 15-4 on the season and 2-1 in East Group B play.
